MODEL OF A GRADE: grade £/kg = anchor (HRC GBP 0.661 / CRC-HDG GBP 0.756 delivered mill base, or wire rod GBP 0.601) + published extra where one was found + service-centre processing (not found). Because grade extras were not found, the anchors alone cannot reprice the AHSS / PHS / electrical rows.

CURRENT-BOOK CHECKS (confident): (1) Cast-metal rows are delivered-casting-style prices, not charge: GJL-250 0.64 vs derived bought charge ~0.17; GJS-500-7 0.86 vs ~0.29; GS-C25 / WCB / G20Mn5 2.10 vs ~0.14 + Mn/Si trim; CF8 5.17 vs ~1.81 (virgin-units upper bound). Even allowing generously for the unpriced trims, melt loss and a delivered-scrap premium, the book is 2-15x the charge cost — consistent with RULES' known error. (2) DC04 0.77 / DC05 0.80 / DC06 0.85 below DC01 0.91 is inverted: deep-drawing grades sit on the same CR base (EUR 880 delivered = GBP 0.756) PLUS a positive grade extra; the size of the extra was not found. DC01 0.91 is GBP 0.15 over the mill CR base (plausible service-centre premium, not confirmed).
